original.target_description: Adult female rat offspring ASR after prenatal control, DEX or CMS exposure, with or without previous blood sampling; p. 60 includes initial-block and final-block omnibus effects, blood-sampling-by-week interaction and subgroup post hoc comparisons. The supplied description and page do not uniquely identify a test.

n.sample_role: Female rat offspring tested at 6 months; Fig. 3 reports a per-group range, not a critical-test total. Prenatal exposure and prior blood sampling define separate groups; week is repeated within animal.
n.exclusions: No exact final ASR group counts or target-specific exclusions are provided in the inspected methods/results/Fig. 3. Recruitment dams and litter counts are separate roles and cannot establish analytic offspring N.
n.location: pp. 57–60, sections 2.4, 2.6–2.7 and 3.3; p. 60, Fig. 3 caption
n.quote: Data are shown as mean + SEM, n = 12 – 20.

notes: Only unfinished field n_o was assigned. All unassigned fields and replication/success entries are placeholders. Title and DOI match the assigned original primary work. Canonical text inspected, and published p. 60 rendered and visually checked. The broad locator leaves multiple candidates: initial-block prenatal-exposure F(2,92) = 5.130; P < 0.01; blood-sampling-by-week F(2,92) = 12.570; P = 0.001; final-block prenatal-exposure F(2,86) = 7.157; P = 0.001. Initial-block blood-sampled DEX/CMS versus control comparisons differ by week; final-block week-2 DEX P < 0.05 and CMS P < 0.005 are further candidates. These printed statistics are contextual candidates only, not selected target values. Fig. 3 supplies only n = 12 – 20 across groups; it gives no exact counts for each of the six exposure-by-blood-sampling cells. No analytic N is inferred from degrees of freedom, the sample range, the 66 recruited dams, the Table 2 litter counts, or the selection of two offspring per litter. No arithmetic derivation is defensible. Original n remains null and target_match remains null.
